The test class compiled successfully. I created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/ArrayUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `ArrayUtils`'s documented contract: the `EMPTY_*` and `INDEX_NOT_FOUND`/`SOFT_MAX_ARRAY_LENGTH` constants, `add`/`addAll`/`addFirst`/`insert` (including null-handling and `IndexOutOfBoundsException`/`IllegalArgumentException` cases), `clone`, `contains`/`containsAny`, `get`, `getComponentType`/`getLength`/`hashCode`, `indexOf`/`lastIndexOf`/`indexesOf` (with start-index clamping semantics), `isArrayIndexValid`, `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`, `isSameLength`/`isSameType`, `isSorted`, `newInstance`, `nullTo`/`nullToEmpty`, `remove`/`removeAll`/`removeAllOccurrences`/`removeElement`/`removeElements`, `reverse`/`shift`/`shuffle`/`swap`/`subarray` (boundary clamping and direction-agnostic invariants for `shift`), `toArray`/`toMap`/`toObject`/`toPrimitive`/`toString`/`toStringArray`, `arraycopy`, and the deprecated `isEquals`.

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
